allow: Bash(cd HyperBEAM && rebar3 as genesis_wasm compile)

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+src/'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive command on src/' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(lua|js)$'; then echo "File modified: $FILE — run yarn test to verify" >&2; fi; exit 0

MSG='WAO context restored after compaction: Send().receive() does NOT work on genesis-wasm — use fire-and-forget + separate AOS scripts. Action tags must be uppercase. Always kill stale beam.smp before HyperBEAM tests. Always call hbeam.kill() in after(). Read docs/ for full API references: wao-sdk.md (JS), aos-lua.md (Lua), hyperbeam-devices.md (devices), hyperbeam-dev.md (Erlang), debug.md (troubleshooting). Dashboard: yarn start (API :3333 + Vite :5174). MCP: get_progress / open_dashboard.'; if [ -f tasks.json ]; then FEATURE=$(cat tasks.json | jq -r '.feature // "unknown"'); STEP=$(cat tasks.json | jq -r '.current_step // 0'); PENDING=$(cat tasks.json | jq '[.tasks[] | select(.status != "done")] | length'); MSG="$MSG BUILD STATE: \"$FEATURE\" — step $STEP, $PENDING tasks remaining."; fi; echo "$MSG"

if [ -f tasks.json ] && [ -f plan.md ]; then STEP=$(cat tasks.json | jq -r '.current_step // 0'); PENDING=$(cat tasks.json | jq '[.tasks[] | select(.status != "done")] | length'); FEATURE=$(cat tasks.json | jq -r '.feature // "unknown"'); echo "BUILD RESUME: \"$FEATURE\" has $PENDING remaining tasks (current_step: $STEP). Read tasks.json and resume /build from the first pending task."; else echo 'NO ACTIVE BUILD: Run /build <feature> to start a new build workflow.'; fi

INPUT=$(cat); TASK=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.task.subject // empty'); if echo "$TASK" | grep -qiE '(build|implement|add|create|fix|update)'; then echo '=== Unit tests ===' >&2; cd "$(pwd)" && yarn test 2>&1 | tail -5; R1=$?; R2=0; R3=0; if command -v erl >/dev/null 2>&1 && ls test/*.test.js >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '=== HyperBEAM integration ===' >&2; yarn test 2>&1 | tail -5; R2=$?; fi; if [ -d frontend ]; then echo '=== Frontend tests ===' >&2; cd frontend && npm run test:unit 2>&1 | tail -5; R3=$?; cd ..; fi; if [ $R1 -ne 0 ] || [ $R2 -ne 0 ] || [ $R3 -ne 0 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Tests are failing. Fix before marking complete.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0
INPUT=$(cat); REASON=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.reason // empty'); if [ "$REASON" = "user" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo 'Check: are all tasks completed and tests passing?' >&2; exit 0
INPUT=$(cat); MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.message // empty'); echo "$MSG" >&2; exit 0
INPUT=$(cat); echo 'Before going idle: verify all assigned tasks are done, tests pass, and no stale beam.smp processes are running.' >&2; exit 0
